subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that contract live under global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the requested fix adds public config and overlaps existing captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions, so maintainer product/API intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with clear bundled-versus-separate semantics, docs, and Telegram-focused tests before implementation.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep voice-with-caption as the supported Telegram behavior and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback as the supported workaround.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 or a replacement to land or close before choosing the separate-delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Add a backward-compatible delivery mode with clear bundled-versus-separate semantics, docs, and Telegram-focused tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both Telegram delivery behavior and the caption-splitting path that this product choice would change.
